name: Proton VPN
author: artemisa81
description: Connect, disconnect and pick a server for Proton VPN from the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Toggle the Proton VPN tunnel, switch servers, and control the firewall.

schema.label: Server list protocol
schema.description: Proton VPN publishes a separate hostname per protocol, so the picker lists one of them.

schema.label: Pause buttons (minutes)
schema.description: Comma-separated durations to offer as pause buttons, e.g. 5,15,30. Up to four, each 1-1440.

schema.label: Look up public IP
schema.description: Ask api.protonvpn.com for your public address so the map can show your real location and ISP. Off by default: it is the widget's only network request.
